us-gaap:CommercialPaper.documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of short-term borrowings using unsecured obligations issued by banks, corporations and other borrowers to investors. The maturities of these money market securities generally do not exceed 270 days.
us-gaap:CommercialPaper.label: Commercial Paper

us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTax.documentation: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.
us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTax.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent

us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxInclu.documentation: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.
us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxInclu.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiability.documentation: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiability.label: Contract with Customer, Liability

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCur.documentation: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCur.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current

us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityNon.documentation: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.
us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityNon.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent

us-gaap:DebtCurrent.documentation: Amount of debt and lease obligation, classified as current.
us-gaap:DebtCurrent.label: Debt, Current

us-gaap:DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombined.documentation: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.
us-gaap:DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombined.label: Debt, Long-Term and Short-Term, Combined Amount

us-gaap:DeferredRevenue.documentation: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.
us-gaap:DeferredRevenue.label: Deferred Revenue

us-gaap:DeferredRevenueCurrent.documentation: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.
us-gaap:DeferredRevenueCurrent.label: Deferred Revenue, Current

us-gaap:DeferredRevenueNoncurrent.documentation: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.
us-gaap:DeferredRevenueNoncurrent.label: Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseLiabilityCurrent.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseLiabilityCurrent.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current

us-gaap:FinanceLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.
us-gaap:FinanceLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-Term Debt

us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.documentation: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.
us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.label: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation

us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.
us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities

us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.
us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.documentation: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current

us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurren.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.
us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurren.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.documentation: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

us-gaap:ShortTermBorrowings.documentation: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
us-gaap:ShortTermBorrowings.label: Short-Term Debt
